title: Verify prime-runner claims against a live Prime Agent epic run
description: prime-runner.md is verified against prime-agent 0.7.0 source and docs, but never exercised end to end. Run a small epic with the adapter and confirm: worktree-process dispatch, --autonomous-gate behaviour, provider failover path, RLM watchdog settling a child that never replies, and detach/reattach of the orchestrator mid-run.
acceptance_criteria: A real epic completes under prime-runner.md; each claim above confirmed or corrected in the adapter
closed_reason: Completed: live epic run in a disposable repo confirmed worktree dispatch, --autonomous-gate (exit 0 == gate passed), boundary check, integrated gate, review + closeout as RLM children, watchdog notice for a non-replying child, continuation into an idle child's intact context, and spawn hard-fail on a bogus selector. Found+fixed live: worktree remove blocked by untracked artifacts; branch-identity hazard (review child left shared checkout on main); implementer template now forbids committing build artifacts. Not verified live: real 429 provider failover, detach/reattach mid-run.
